name: pump_xgboost_gate
summary: The production-fast student of the GMM teacher (agent C). Trains an XGBoost binary classifier (bot=1 / human=0) on GMM-labeled wallet features, then serves sub-ms bot_probability scoring for the surf_executor (agent E). The gate() entrypoint combines XGB bot_probability with a companion human_cluster_inflow_score (0.0-1.0) and emits one of three decisions: 'abort' (pure bot cluster → guaranteed rug), 'surf_candidate' (bot volume + human inflow → surfable pump), or 'hold' (mixed / organic / no momentum). xgboost is the canonical backend; if unavailable, a stdlib gradient-boosting stub (20 stumps, max_depth=3, log-loss residuals, ~120 LOC) provides graceful fallback. Both backends serialize to a single JSON model file at studio/assets/_models/pump_xgb.json that predict_wallet() reads transparently.
engine_pattern: Two paths, one shape. Canonical path: xgb.DMatrix → xgb.train (binary:logistic, max_depth=4, eta=0.2, hist tree method, optional device='cuda' if use_gpu) → booster.save_model. Fallback path: stdlib gradient boosting — base log-odds + 20 trees of depth 3 fit on (gradient, hessian) pairs via Newton-Raphson per node, sigmoid for probability. Both write a JSON file readable by predict_wallet via a kind-sniffing _load_model that checks for 'model_kind=stub_gbm_v1' key vs xgb's native schema. Inference is the same shape — feature dict → row vector via FEATURE_ORDER (10 features matching pump_feature_extractor agent B) → probability.

abort.meaning: Pure bot cluster, no human interest detected. Guaranteed rug. Surf-executor MUST NOT touch.
abort.action: skip event, log crystal, no order placed

surf_candidate.meaning: Bots are doing volume AND humans are flooding in — the classical surfable pump signature. Buy in, ride momentum, sell on bot exit signal.

hold_bot_uncertain.meaning: Bot signature present but human signal ambiguous. Wait for human-inflow to cross 0.40 or bot pattern to drop.

hold_organic.meaning: Organic / human-driven activity. No bot-driven momentum to surf yet.
hold_organic.action: no action, monitor for bot entry

hold_mixed.meaning: Mixed signal, classifier uncertain. Default safe = hold.
hold_mixed.action: no action, log crystal with reason='mixed_signal'

expected_tools: train_xgb(features_csv, gmm_labels_csv, model_out_path=None, use_gpu=True) -> metrics dict

env_vars.(none required): Stdlib + optional xgboost. No env vars.

substrate: studio/assets/_models/pump_xgb.json (XGB native JSON dump OR stub JSON ensemble — same path, sniffed at load) + crystal chain entries tier='ml_train' model='pump_xgboost' scope='xgb_trained' and tier='ml_inference' model='pump_xgboost_gate' scope='gate_decision'

inbound_callers: surf_executor (agent E) — per-event gate() invocation in real time
core/lib/defi_loop.py — bulk inference for backtesting / replay
outbound_calls: pump_gmm_classifier (agent C) — TEACHER, provides cluster labels for training
inference_logger.log — fire-and-forget crystal chain anchor (tier=ml_train | ml_inference)
routing_connections.substrate_reads: features CSV (extractor output) + GMM labels CSV (classifier output) at train time; pump_xgb.json at inference time
routing_connections.substrate_writes: pump_xgb.json on train; crystal chain on every call

fallback_strategy.trigger: xgboost not importable (no pip, no system pkg)
fallback_strategy.engine: Stdlib gradient-boosting ensemble (20 decision stumps, max_depth=3, lr=0.3, log-loss residuals, Newton-Raphson leaf values with L2 reg lam=1.0)
fallback_strategy.feature_parity: Same FEATURE_ORDER + same JSON file path. _load_model() sniffs model_kind key to route to the right predictor.
fallback_strategy.performance_note: Fallback is deterministic (seed=42) but ~10× slower than xgboost (still well under target 10ms for the 10-feature single-row case). Holdout accuracy on a clean separable synth corpus matches xgboost within ~5%.
fallback_strategy.rule: ALWAYS document fallback in card. xgboost is canonical; stub is for portability.

performance_targets.inference_latency_ms: < 10ms per call (xgboost: <1ms; stub: <5ms for 20-stump×depth-3 on 10 features)
performance_targets.crystal_log_blocking_behavior: FIRE_AND_FORGET — exception caught, warned to stderr, gate decision unaffected

smoke_test_protocol.2_train: python3 core/lib/pump_xgboost_gate.py train /tmp/pump_features_smoke.csv /tmp/pump_gmm_labels.csv --cpu → metrics JSON with holdout_acc, backend, feature_importance
smoke_test_protocol.4_gate_surf: human_inflow=0.55 with same high-bot-prob features → decision='surf_candidate', reason='bot_volume_plus_human_inflow'

guarantees: Inference path NEVER blocks on crystal logging — exceptions caught, warning to stderr, decision returned
Feature order is canonical (FEATURE_ORDER constant) — predictor and extractor MUST agree by key name
Deterministic training (seed=42 in both backends) → same input CSVs → same model bytes
xgboost optional — stub fallback ensures the gate works on any stdlib-only host
Single model file path — both backends write studio/assets/_models/pump_xgb.json
constraints_from_card: Stdlib only at runtime; xgboost graceful-optional
Do NOT pip install — fallback is the portability guarantee
Do NOT touch pump_gmm_classifier, pump_feature_extractor, cc.sh, .env, model_api.py
ONLY this file + this card may be created
usage_example:
from core.lib.pump_xgboost_gate import gate, train_xgb
# At training time (offline):
metrics = train_xgb('features.csv', 'gmm_labels.csv')
# At inference time (hot path):
d = gate(wallet_feature_row={'wallet': 'X', 'tx_per_block': 0.5, ...},
          human_cluster_inflow_score=0.45)
if d.decision == 'surf_candidate':
    surf_executor.queue(d.wallet)
phase: DeFi pump.fun surf gating — production-fast student of GMM teacher (parallel agent D of pump pipeline: B=extractor, C=GMM teacher, D=XGB student, E=surf executor)
